senses.gloss:
परि-√ गण् P. -गणयति (ind.p. -गण्य), to count over, reckon up completely, ascertain by calculation, Suśr.; Hcar.; BhP.;
to calculate, reckon, consider, reflect, Megh. (cf. अपरिगणयत्).
परि-गणन n.
परि-गणना f. complete enumeration, accurate calculation or statement, Megh.; Kull.
परि-गणनीय (Kull.) mfn. to be enumerated completely or stated accurately.
परि-गण्य (see अ-परिग्˚) mfn. to be enumerated completely or stated accurately.
परि-गणित mfn. enumerated, calculated, reckoned, BhP. (cf. अ-परिग्˚).
परि-गणितिन् mfn. one who has well considered everything, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 36, Kāś.
परिगण m. or n. (?), a house, L.
परि-√ गद् (only inf. -गदितुम्), to describe, relate, tell, Bhām. ii, 75.
परि-गदितिन् mfn. = परिगदितं येन सः, g. इष्टादि.

परि-√ गम् P. -गच्छति (aor. -अगमत्, AV.; -ग्मन्, RV.; pf. -जग्मतुः, MBh.; p. -जगन्वस्, RV.; ind.p. -ग॑त्या or -ग॑त्य, RV.; ŚBr.; -गम्य, MBh.; inf. -गन्तुम्, R.),
to go round or about or through, circumambulate, surround, inclose, RV. &c. &c.;
to come to any state or condition, get, attain (acc.), MBh. :
Pass. -गम्यते, MBh. :
Caus. -गमयति, to cause to go round, to pass or spend (time), Ragh. viii, 91.
परि-ग mfn. going round, surrounding, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 38, Sch.
प॑रिग-धिता f. firmly embraced, RV. i, 126, 6.
परि-गत mfn. gone round or through, surrounded, encompassed, MBh.; R. &c.
filled, possessed of, visited by, afflicted with (instr. or comp.), ib.
diffused, spread, Kāv.
deceased, dead, Bhartṛ. iii, 49
experienced, known, learnt from (abl.), Kāv.
forgotten, L.
obtained, L.
= चेष्टित, L.
परि-ग˚तार्थ mfn. acquainted or familiar with anything, Kālid.
परि-गन्तव्य mfn. to be got or obtained, L.
परि-गम m. going round, surrounding, Bālar.
knowing, ascertaining, partaking of, occupation with (comp.), ib.; Pracaṇḍ.
spreading, extending, W.
obtaining, ib.
परि-गमन n. id., MW.
परि-गमित mfn. (fr. Caus.) brought, conducted, driven, passed, spent (time), Ragh.
परि-गम्य mfn. accessible, to be circumambulated (अ-परिग्˚), KātyŚr.
परि-√ गर्ज् P. -गर्जति, to roar, cry, scold, R.
परि-गर्वित mfn. (√ गर्व्) very proud or arrogant, Cāṇ.

परि-√ गर्ह् Ā. -गर्हते, to blame greatly, censure, despise, abuse, MBh. :
Caus. -गर्हयति id., ib.
परि-गर्हण n. excessive blame, censure, ib.
परि-गलित mfn. (√ गल्) fallen down, MBh.
sunk, Pañc.
flowing, fluid, melted, W.
परि-गहन n. g. क्षुभ्नादि.
परि-गुणित mfn. (fr. -गुणय) reiterated, repeated, BhP.
augmented by addition of (comp.), VarBṛS. lxv, 5.
परि-गुण्ठित mfn. (√ गुण्ठ्) veiled in, hidden by (instr.), R.
परि-गुण्डित mfn. covered with dust, Śīl.
परि-√ गुप् only Desid. -जुगुप्सते, to beware of, be on one's guard against (abl.), MBh.
परि-गूढक mfn. g. ऋश्यादि.
परि-गृद्ध mfn. very greedy, Divyāv.
परि-ग्रेध (!) m. excessive greediness, L.

परि-√ गै P. -गायति, to go about singing, sing or celebrate everywhere, TS.; ŚBr.; ŚrS.;
to proclaim aloud (esp. Pass. -गीयते), MBh. &c.
परि-गीत mfn. sung, celebrated, proclaimed, declared, MBh.; BhP.
परि-गीति f. a kind of metre, Col.
परि-√ ग्रस् P. Ā. -ग्रसति, ˚ते, to devour, NṛsUp.
परि-गृहीत mfn. taken hold of on both sides, AV.
surrounded, embraced, enclosed, enveloped, fenced, TS.; ŚBr.; MBh. &c.
seized, grasped, taken, received, obtained, accepted, adopted, admitted, followed, obeyed, Br.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
opposed, checked, W.
परि-गृहीत m. g. आचितादि.
प॑रि-गृहीति (प॑रि-), f. grasping, comprehension, TS.; Br.
परि-गृहीतृ w.r. for ˚ग्रह्˚.
1. परि-गृह्य ind. having taken or seized, in company or along with (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
considering, regarding, W.
2. परि-गृह्य mfn. to be taken or accepted or regarded, W.
परि-गृह्या f. designation of a partic. kind of Vedi or sacrificial mound, Kauś.
a married woman, L.
परि-गृ॑ह्य—वत् (˚गृ॑ह्य-), mfn. containing the word परिगृह्य, TS.
परि-ग्रह॑ m. (ifc. f(आ). ) laying hold of on all sides, surrounding, enclosing, fencing round (esp. the Vedi or sacrificial altar by means of three lines or furrows), ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c.
wrapping round, putting on (a dress &c.), assuming (a form &c.), Kāv.
comprehending, summing up, sum, totality, ŚāṅkhBr.; Mn.
taking, accepting, receiving or anything received, a gift or present, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
getting, attaining, acquisition, possession, property (ifc. ‘being possessed of or furnished with’), ib.
household, family, attendants, retinue, the seraglio of a prince, ib.
a house, abode, Hariv.
root, origin, foundation, MBh.
admittance (into one's house), hospitable reception, Mn.; MBh.; R.; Kāraṇḍ.
taking (a wife), marrying, marriage, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a wife (also collect.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
choice, selection, ib.
understanding, conception, Pāṇ., Sch.
undertaking, beginning, commission or performance of, occupation with, Mn.; R.; Hariv.
homage, reverence, grace, favour, help, assistance, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
dominion, control (ifc. ‘dependent on, subject to’), R.; Var.; MārkP.
force, constraint, punishment (opp. to अनु-ग्रह), R.
claim on, relation to, concern with (loc.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(in Ved. gram.) the double mention of a word both before and after इति
the form which precedes इति, RPrāt.
a curse, imprecation, oath, L.
an eclipse of the sun, L.
the rear or reserve of an army, L. (v.l. प्रति-ग्र्˚)
परि-ग्राह॑ m. the surrounding or fencing round of the Vedi or sacrificial altar with three lines or furrows, TS.
परि-ग्रह—त्व n. state of a wife, marriage, Daś.
परि-ग्रह—द्वितीय mfn. accompanied by one's wife or family, MW.
परि-ग्रह—बहु-त्व n. multitude of wives, Śak.
परि-ग्रह—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of a family, Prab.
परि-ग्रह—वत् mfn. possessed of wealth, having property, MBh.
परि-ग्र˚हिन् mfn. possessed of wealth, having property, MBh.
परि-ग्र˚हार्थीय mfn. having the sense of comprehension i.e. generalization, Nir. i, 7.
परि-ग्रहक mfn. grasping, taking hold of, undertaking (ifc.), L.
परि-ग्राहक mfn. favouring, befriending, Bālar.
परि-ग्रहण n. wrapping round, putting on Prab.
परि-ग्रहीतव्य mfn. to be admitted or supposed, Śaṃk.
to be ruled or controlled, Pat.
to be taken hold of or got into possession, Vajracch.
परि-ग्रहीतृ mfn. taking hold of, seizing
परि-ग्रहीतृ m. assister, helper, VāyuP.
ruler, Pat.
an adoptive father, Pravar.; Kull.
a husband, Śak.
परि-ग्राह्य mfn. to be treated or addressed kindly, MBh.
परि-ग्लान mfn. (√ ग्लै) wearied out, languid, exhausted, MBh.; R. &c.
averse from (dat.), Pat.
पारि—ग्रामिक mf(ई)n. (-ग्रामम्) situated round a village, ib. iv, 3, 61.
